summary: Apply BABOK practices to requirements, traceability and solution decisions. Explore the five-day advanced course and its practical work products.
lede: Business analysis training helps analysts, product owners and process specialists turn business needs into testable requirements and recommendations. Using the BABOK Guide and BACCM, learners frame change, map stakeholders, and trace and prioritize requirements. They also model processes with BPMN and assess solution options against business value, performance measures and acceptance criteria.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who already contribute to business change and need a more consistent way to frame needs, manage requirements and evaluate solution options.
modules: User Stories and Use Case Models
prerequisites: Prior experience contributing to business analysis, requirements work or business change is expected. Familiarity with stakeholder discussions and basic requirements documentation will help you apply the advanced exercises.
